name: Expo Simulators
description: Runs remote iOS Simulators and Android Emulators that coding agents start, drive, and screenshot to test mobile apps, via the EAS CLI or REST API.

skills.name: Start Remote Device
skills.description: Starts a remote iOS Simulator or Android Emulator session on Expo infrastructure with eas simulator:start or the REST API.

skills.name: Install App Build
skills.description: Installs an Expo Build, a build fingerprint match, an app archive URL, or Expo Go on the remote device for testing.

skills.name: Drive the Device
skills.description: Controls the running app through agent-device, Argent, or Appium: opens apps, presses buttons, enters text, reads the UI tree.

skills.name: Capture Evidence
skills.description: Captures screenshots, screen recordings, and logs from a remote simulator session to return as proof that a change works.

skills.name: Share Browser Preview
skills.description: Opens a live browser preview of the remote device session that teammates can open from a link or you can embed in a page.
